Haata'u malee, yaalii dhiibbaa siyaasaa kana hundumaa darbee, mana murtii ICC'n Neetanyaahuu fi hoggantoota biroo irratti ajaja hidhaa baasuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Trump says US-Saudi strikes in Iraq were 'coordinated' with Baghdad
english: Former President Donald Trump stated in an interview that recent military strikes conducted by the United States and Saudi Arabia against Iran-supported factions in Iraq were planned alongside the Iraqi government. This assertion suggests that the Iraqi administration was fully aware of and involved in the operation. The claim emerged during a discussion on Fox News regarding regional security actions.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራቅ ውስጥ በኢራን በሚደገፉ ታጣቂዎች ላይ የተፈጸመው የአሜሪካ እና የሳውዲ አረቢያ የጋራ ጥቃት ከኢራቅ መንግስት ጋር በመቀናጀት የተከናወነ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የኢራቅ አስተዳደር በጥቃቱ እቅድ እና አፈጻጸም ላይ ቀጥተኛ ግንዛቤ እንደነበረው ያሳያል። ጉዳዩ የተነሳው ከፎክስ ኒውስ ጋር ባደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp, tarkaanfii waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Sa'udii Arabaa gara Iiraaqitti gareewwan Iiraan deeggartu irratti fudhatame mootummaa Iiraaq waliin qindaa'ee kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun mootummaan Iiraaq waa'ee tarkaanfichaa beekumsa qabaachuu fi qindoomina keessa akka ture kan agarsiisuudha. Yaanni kunis yeroo inni gara Fox News waliin gaaffii fi deebii godhachaa turanitti kan ka'e dha.

title: US prosecutor who helped ICC's Karim Khan seek Israeli arrest warrants breaks her silence
english: Brenda Hollis, the American prosecutor who led the team investigating war crimes in Palestine, has publicly supported Karim Khan's decision to seek arrest warrants for Israeli and Hamas leaders. She rejected claims that the process was rushed or politically motivated, stating that the applications were based on rigorous legal analysis and solid evidence. Hollis emphasized that the recent removal of Karim Khan from his role should remain separate from the legitimacy of the war crimes investigations his team conducted.
amharic: በፍልስጤም የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ቡድንን የመሩት አሜሪካዊቷ አቃቤ ህግ ብሬንዳ ሆሊስ፣ ከሪም ካን የእስራኤል እና የሃማስ መሪዎችን ለማሰር ያቀረቡትን ጥያቄ በይፋ ደግፈዋል። ጥያቄው የተጣደፈ ወይም ፖለቲካዊ ነው የሚለውን ክስ ውድቅ ያደረጉት ሆሊስ፣ ውሳኔው በጠንካራ የህግ ትንተና እና በበቂ ማስረጃ ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። የከሪም ካን ከስልጣን መነሳት በቡድናቸው የተከናወነውን የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ህጋዊነት ሊያደበዝዝ እንደማይገባም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Ameerikaa garee yakka waraanaa Falasxiin qorataa ture hogganaa turan Brenda Hollis, murtee Karim Khan hogganoota Israa'el fi Hamaas hidhuuf dhiyeessan deggaranii jiru. Himannaa qorannoon kun ariifannaa fi siyaasaan kan guutame jedhu dhugaa akka hin taane ibsuun, gaaffiin kun qorannoo seeraa cimaa fi ragaa gahaa irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu mirkaneessan. Akkasumas, Karim Khan aangoo irraa kaafamuun isaanii qorannoo yakka waraanaa gareen isaanii gaggeessan irratti dhiibbaa uumuu akka hin qabne ibsanii jiru.

title: Iraqi group threatens US and Saudi interests after deadly attacks
english: A powerful Iraqi militia backed by Iran has vowed to retaliate against the United States and Saudi Arabia following joint military strikes on their positions. These overnight attacks across several Iraqi provinces resulted in at least 20 deaths and over 30 injuries among the Popular Mobilisation Forces. This development has sparked significant concern regarding a potential increase in regional violence and direct threats to American and Saudi interests.
amharic: ኢራን የምትደግፈው የኢራቅ ታጣቂ ቡድን አሜሪካ እና ሳውዲ አረቢያ በጋራ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ አስታውቋል። በሰባት የኢራቅ ግዛቶች በተፈጸመው የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 20 የፖፑላር ሞቢላይዜሽን ኃይላት ተዋጊዎች ሲሞቱ ከ30 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ተባብሶ ግጭቶች ሊስፋፉ ይችላሉ የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni hidhattoota Iraaq kan biyya Iraan deggeramu, haleellaa gamtaan Ameerikaa fi Saudii Arabiyaa bakkeewwan isaanii irratti raawwatan booda tarkaanfii haaloo ba'uu fudhachuuf wadaa galeera. Haleellaa halkan tokko keessatti godinoota Iraaq gara garaa irratti raawwatameen loltoota 'Popular Mobilisation Forces' keessaa 20 ol ajjeefamanii, 30 ol immoo madaa'aniiru. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hammeessuu fi fedhii Ameerikaa fi Saudii irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
english: A powerful earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu region, resulting in at least 13 deaths and causing significant structural damage. Rescue teams are currently working urgently to find survivors trapped under debris, including at a shopping mall and a factory. Authorities have reported over 100 aftershocks and are warning residents to remain cautious as the danger of further seismic activity persists.
amharic: ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በጃፓን የኪዩሹ ክልል በመከሰቱ ቢያንስ 13 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በህንፃዎች ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የተጠመዱ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ከ100 በላይ ተከታይ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት ተጨማሪ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ሊከሰት ስለሚችል ነዋሪዎች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humni lafa socho'ee biyya Jaappan naannoo Kyuushuu keessatti mudateen lubbuun namoota 13 ol darbeera. Gareewwan fayyisituu ijoollee fi namoota iddoo garaa garaa keessatti caccabaa mana jala jiran baasuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jiru. sochiin lafaa kanaan boodas yeroo 100 ol kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, mootummaan namoonni akka of eeggannoo guddaa godhan akeekkachiiseera.

title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with facilitating terrorism
english: Russian authorities have officially charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov with enabling terrorism, claiming his platform is being used by Ukrainian intelligence for sabotage. An international arrest warrant has been issued for the billionaire, who currently resides outside of Russia. Durov, who has long faced pressure from the Kremlin, continues to maintain that these accusations are merely excuses to censor the popular messaging app.
amharic: የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት የቴሌግራም መስራች ፓቬል ዱሮቭ የዩክሬን የስለላ ድርጅቶች በሀገሪቱ ላይ ጥቃት እንዲፈጽሙ መድረክ በመፍጠር አሸባሪነትን አበረታተዋል በሚል ክስ መስርተውባቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ከሩሲያ ውጭ የሚኖሩት ቢሊየነሩ ዱሮቭ ላይ አለም አቀፍ የእስር ትዕዛዝ ተላልፏል። ዱሮቭ በበኩላቸው፣ የሩሲያ መንግስት ይህንን መተግበሪያ ለመቆጣጠር እና ሳንሱር ለማድረግ ሲባል የሚደረግ የፖለቲካ ሴራ ነው በማለት ክሱን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ruusiyaa hundeeessaa Telegraam Paavel Duroov irratti, ergaa dabarsichi akka meeshaatti itti fayyadamamee qindoomina shororkeessummaa fi sabootaatoo akka gaggeeffamu gargaareera jechuun himata baneera. Biroon nageenyaa Ruusiyaa (FSB) Telegraam tajaajila iccitii Yuukreenif bakka mijataa ta'eera jedhee himata. Biliyoonara kana irratti ajajni qabamuu idil-addunyaa kan bahe yoo ta'u, Duroov garuu himatni kun mala qulqulluu fi hidhattoota isaa to'achuuf mootummaan itti fayyadamu akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Infantino’s FIFA World Cup stakes plan: Would UEFA boycott, would it work?
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing significant backlash over a proposal to sell minority stakes in future World Cup tournaments to private investors. The plan involves creating a 20 billion dollar subsidiary, known as the FIFA Forward Enterprise, to boost global football revenue. However, European football officials and political leaders have strongly criticized the move, with some suggesting that UEFA might boycott the events in response.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለወደፊት የዓለም ዋንጫ ውድድሮች ድርሻቸውን ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ባቀረቡት ሀሳብ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። እቅዱ የፊፋን ዓለም አቀፍ ገቢ ለመጨመር 'ፊፋ ፎርዋርድ ኢንተርፕራይዝ' የተሰኘ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ካፒታል ያለው ተቋም ማቋቋምን ያካትታል። ይሁን እንጂ የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር እና ሌሎች የፖለቲካ መሪዎች ይህንን ሀሳብ በጽኑ በመቃወም ውድድሩን ባለመቀላቀል የመቀጠብ ስጋትን አንስተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo fuuldura duratti qooda tapha waancaa addunyaa investaroota dhuunfaaf gurguruuf karoorfachuun isaanii mormii cimaa uumeera. Karoorri kun galii kubbaa miilaa addunyaa dabaluuf dhaabbata 'FIFA Forward Enterprise' jedhamu kan qarshii biliyoona 20 qabu ijaaruu kan jedhu dha. Haa ta'u malee, hoggantoonni kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa fi geggeessitoonni siyaasaa karoora kana cimaatti kan morman yoo ta'u, UEFA taphicha dhaabuuf yaada dhiyeessuu danda'u.

title: ‘Iran attacks now to send message as US assets build up in Israel’
english: Following a brief period of stability, Iran has renewed its missile strikes against United States military forces stationed in the Middle East. Experts believe this escalation is a calculated signal sent in response to the increased presence of American military equipment and personnel in Israel. This move highlights growing regional tensions as Iran aims to demonstrate its resolve amidst the ongoing buildup of US assets.
amharic: ለአምስት ቀናት ከቆየው መረጋጋት በኋላ ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ከፍታለች። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በእስራኤል ውስጥ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ሀብቶች እየጨመሩ በመምጣታቸው ለመቃወም ነው። ኢራን ይህን ድርጊት የፈጸመችው በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ባለው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ መልእክት ለማስተላለፍ እንደሆነ ታምኖበታል።
oromo: Guyyoota shanif tasgabbii booda, Iraan naannicha keessa kan jiran waraana Ameerikaa irratti xiyyaara waraanaa (missile) dhukaastee jirti. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame Ameerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa fi humna ishee gara Israa'el waan dabarsiteef of ittisuu fi akeekkachiisa dabarsuufi. Gochi kun, dhiibbaa fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan dabaluu fi Iraan humna ishee agarsiisuuf yaaltu akka ta'e eerameera.

title: Married couple deported by ICE killed in Guatemala
english: A married couple who were recently deported from the United States by ICE were tragically murdered after returning to Guatemala. Their bodies were discovered with gunshot wounds and signs of restraint, while their toddler daughter was found alive at the scene. This incident has raised significant concerns regarding the safety of individuals sent back to their home countries.
amharic: ከአሜሪካ በኢሚግሬሽን ባለሥልጣናት ተባረው ወደ ጉዋቲማላ የተመለሱ ባለትዳሮች በግፍ ተገድለዋል። ጥንዶቹ በጥይት ተመትተው በታሰረ ሁኔታ የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ የ14 ወር ሴት ልጃቸው ግን በሕይወት ተገኝታለች። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ከአሜሪካ ወደ ሀገራቸው የሚመለሱ ስደተኞች ደህንነት ላይ ትልቅ ጥያቄን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbaan manaa fi haati manaa biyya Ameerikaa irraa gara biyya isaanii Gwaatemaalaatti deebifaman ajjeechaa raawwatamee irratti lubbuun isaanii darbe. Reeffi isaanii hidhamanii fi rasaasaan rukutamanii argame yoo ta'u, mucayyoon isaanii kan ji'a 14 ammoo cina isaanii lubbuun argamteetti. Gochi kun namoota biyya isaaniitti deebifaman haala nageenyaa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: EU crisis chief urges tougher climate action amid France, Spain wildfires
english: The EU's crisis management chief has called for increased funding and faster climate action following massive wildfires in France and Spain. With over 330,000 people forced to flee their homes due to the fires, officials emphasize that global warming is occurring faster than expected. The region is now bracing for another extreme heatwave, prompting urgent calls to prioritize disaster prevention and better forest management.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት የቀውስ አስተዳደር ኃላፊ በፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን በተከሰተው የሰደድ እሳት ሳቢያ ለችግሩ ፈጣን ምላሽ መስጠት እና የገንዘብ ድጋፍን ማሳደግ እንደሚያስፈልግ አስታውቀዋል። ከ330,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ያደረገው ይህ አደጋ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ከታሰበው በላይ በፍጥነት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። አሁን ክልሉ ሌላ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እየጠበቀ በመሆኑ፣ የአደጋ መከላከል እና የደን አስተዳደር ስራዎች ቅድሚያ ሊሰጣቸው እንደሚገባ ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Hogganaan bulchiinsa rakkoo biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa, ibiddii bosonaa Faransaayii fi Ispeen keessatti ka'een walqabatee gargaarsa maallaqaa dabaluu fi tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhachuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Namoonni kuma 330 ol ta'an ibiddichaan walqabatee iddoo jireenya isaanii gadhiisanii baqachuun isaanii, jijjiiramni qilleensaa yaadamee olitti saffisaan akka jiru agarsiisa. Naannichi ammas hoo'a cimaa biraaf waan qophaa'aa jiruuf, dhimma balaa ittisuu fi bulchiinsa bosonaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun dirqama ta'eera.

title: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with ‘aiding terrorism’
english: Russian authorities have accused Telegram co-founder Pavel Durov of facilitating terrorism, claiming his platform allows groups to coordinate attacks and illegal activities. An international arrest warrant has been issued for the tech entrepreneur, who currently resides outside of Russia. While Moscow seeks to limit the use of encrypted apps in favor of state-controlled services, Durov maintains that these accusations are politically motivated attempts to undermine digital privacy.
amharic: የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት የቴሌግራም መስራች ፓቬል ዱሮቭ ሽብርተኝነትን በማገዝ ከሰሱ። የሩሲያ ደህንነት ኤጀንሲ (ኤፍ.ኤስ.ቢ) የመልእክት መላኪያ መድረኩ ለተለያዩ ጥቃቶችና ወንጀሎች የተቀናጀ ስራ እንደሚውል በመግለጽ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የእስር ማዘዣ አውጥቷል። ዱሮቭ በበኩሉ እነዚህ ክሶች በግላዊነት እና በነጻ ሀሳብ መግለጫ ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው ሲል ይከራከራል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ruusiyaa hundeeessaa Telegraam Paavel Duroov shororkeessummaa gargaare jedhee himateera. Ejensiin nageenyaa biyyattii (FSB), appilikeeshiniin kun gareewwan yakka hojjetan akka wal-qindeessan gargaara jechuun, isa irratti ajaja hidhaa idil-addunyaa baaseera. Paavel Duroov gama isaatiin, himannoon kun mirga iccitii fi yaada ibsachuu miidhuuf kan ka'e malee, dhugaa akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: ‘The war caused this’: Miscarriages soar in Gaza amid Israeli bombing and siege
english: Miscarriage rates in Gaza have surged dramatically since the conflict began, with recent data showing a significant increase compared to pre-war levels. The ongoing bombardment and destruction of infrastructure prevent many pregnant women from accessing necessary medical care, forcing them to travel long distances on foot. Experts emphasize that the true impact of this crisis is likely even higher than official records suggest due to the difficulty of documenting cases amid the widespread devastation.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነትና የሕክምና አገልግሎት መስተጓጎል በነፍሰ ጡር ሴቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ በማሳደሩ የፅንስ መጨንገፍ ምጣኔ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። የተጎዱ መንገዶችና የትራንስፖርት እጥረት ሴቶች ለሕክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል እንዳይደርሱ በማድረጋቸው፣ ብዙዎቹ ረጅም ርቀት በእግር ለመጓዝ ተገደዋል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት፣ አሁን ያለው የፅንስ መጨንገፍ ቁጥር ከጦርነቱ በፊት ከነበረው ጋር ሲነጻጸር እጅግ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee, baay’inni ulfa ba’uu (miscarriage) sadarkaa ulfaataa irra ga’eera. Daandiiwwan diigamanii fi tajaajilli geejjibaa guutummaatti dhaabbachuu isaatiin, dubartoonni ulfa ta’an gargaarsa fayyaa argachuuf fageenya dheeraa miilaan deemuf dirqamaa jiru. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka ibsanitti, rakkoo kanaaf saaxilamuun haadholii fi daa’imman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiru.

title: US missile strikes uninhabited area in northwestern Iran: Report
english: Iranian media reports indicate that a US missile landed in an empty field near the northwestern city of Piranshahr. Local officials confirmed that the impact occurred in an unpopulated zone, resulting in no physical damage or injuries to people. The incident remains under observation by regional authorities.
amharic: የኢራን መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት አንድ የአሜሪካ ሚሳኤል በፒራንሻህር ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ሰው አልባ ቦታ ላይ ወድቋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ክስተቱ የደረሰው ሰውን በማይኖርበት አካባቢ በመሆኑ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት ወይም ሞት አላስከተለም። ጉዳዩ በአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ክትትል እየተደረገበት ነው።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen Iran akka gabaasanitti, misaa'elii Ameerikaa tokko magaalaa Piraanashaar biratti lafa namni hin jiraanne irratti kufuu isaa ibsaniiru. Hoji geggeessitoonni naannichaa akka mirkaneessanitti, kufuun misaa'elichaa bakka nama hin jiraanne ta'uu isaa fi miidhaan lubbuu ykn qaamaa namarra hin geenye. Dhimmi kun hordoffii hoji geggeessitoota naannichaa jalatti argama.

title: Iraqi cleric Muqtada al-Sadr condemns attacks by pro-Iranian factions on Saudi Arabia
english: Influential Iraqi cleric Muqtada al-Sadr has publicly criticized pro-Iranian militias for launching attacks from Iraq against Saudi Arabia, warning that these actions threaten national stability. His statement follows a deadly joint US-Saudi strike that killed several members of the Popular Mobilisation forces in retaliation. Sadr is calling for the Iraqi government to regain full control to prevent the nation from being dragged into a broader regional conflict.
amharic: የኢራቅ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪው የሃይማኖት መሪ ሙቅታዳ አል-ሳድር፣ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ታጣቂዎች ከኢራቅ ምድር በመነሳት ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አውግዘዋል። ይህ የሳድር አስተያየት የመጣው አሜሪካ እና ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በኢራቅ ታጣቂዎች ላይ በወሰዱት የአጸፋ እርምጃ ከ10 በላይ ሰዎች ከተገደሉ በኋላ ነው። አል-ሳድር ኢራቅን ከክልላዊ ግጭት ለመታደግ መንግሥት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ያለውን ቁጥጥር እንዲያጠናክር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan amantii Iraaq Muqtada al-Sadr, gareewwan hidhattootaa Iraan waliin hidhata qaban biyya Iraaq keessaa ka’uun Sa’udii Arabiyaarratti haleellaa raawwachaa jiran balaaleffateera. Haleellaan kun biyyattii walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa keessa galchuu akka danda’u kan akeekkachiise Sadr, mootummaan Iraaq nageenya biyyattii eeguuf to’annoo isaa cimsuu akka qabu gaafateera. Ibsi kun kan dhufe, haleellaa qindaa’aa Ameerikaa fi Sa’udiin gareewwan kana irratti raawwataniin namoonni 10 ol erga ajjeefamanii boodadha.

title: Houthis weigh fees on commercial ships crossing Bab al-Mandeb
english: Yemen's Houthi rebels are currently planning to impose financial charges on commercial ships navigating through the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. This strategy follows their recent announcement of a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia, threatening a vital international trade and energy corridor. Reports indicate that the group discussed this potential toll system with Iranian officials during a recent visit.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ የሚያልፉ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ክፍያ ለመጣል እቅድ እያወጡ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የባህር በር ለመዝጋት ከወሰኑ በኋላ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ በዓለም አቀፍ የንግድና የኃይል አቅርቦት መስመር ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ቡድኑ ከዚህ እቅድ ጋር በተያያዘ ከኢራን ባለስልጣናት ጋር መወያየቱ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni Houtii kan Yaman, dooniiwwan daldalaa kanneen Bab al-Mandeb keessa darban irratti kaffaltii dirqamaa gochuuf karoorfataa jiru. Karoorri kun erga isaan mootummaa Saudii Arabiyaa irratti duula bishaan keessaa labsanii booda kan dhufe yoo ta'u, kunis karaa daldala fi anniisaa idil-addunyaa irratti balaa uuma. Gareen kun karoora kana irratti hoggantoota Iraan waliin mari'achuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Al-Sadr tells Iran-backed groups to keep Iraq out of war
english: Influential Iraqi cleric Muqtada al-Sadr has formally requested that Iran-supported militias cease launching attacks from Iraqi territory. He warned that such actions risk dragging Iraq into unnecessary regional conflicts and has called on the government to strengthen its authority. Al-Sadr emphasized that the nation deserves peace and should remain independent from foreign military influence.
amharic: የኢራቅ ተደማጭ የሆኑት ሙክታዳ አል-ሳድር በኢራቅ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ኢራን ደጋፊ ታጣቂዎች ከሀገሪቱ ግዛት በመነሳት ጥቃት እንዳይፈጽሙ አስጠንቅቀዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ኢራቅን ወደ አላስፈላጊ ጦርነት ውስጥ ሊከቱ እንደሚችሉ በመግለጽ፣ መንግስት የሀገር ውስጥ ቁጥጥሩን እንዲያጠናክር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። አል-ሳድር አክለውም የኢራቅ ህዝብ ሰላም እንደሚያስፈልገው እና ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ ገብነት ነጻ መሆን እንዳለበት ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun amantii Iraaq Muqtaadaa Al-Saadir, gareelee hidhattootaa kanneen Iraaniin deggaraman biyyattii keessaa ka'anii haleellaa akka hin raawwanne akeekkachiisaniiru. Gochi kun Iraaqiin waraana biroo keessatti akka hindeebineef jecha, mootummaan aangoo isaa cimsatee biyya bulchuu akka qabu dhaamaniiru. Al-Saadir, ummanni Iraaq nagaa akka barbaaduu fi dhiibbaa waraana alaa irraa bilisa ta'uu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: US and Saudi Arabia strike ‘Iran-aligned’ groups in Iraq
english: The United States and Saudi Arabia conducted coordinated airstrikes against Iran-affiliated militias in Iraq. This military action was launched as a response to recent drone attacks that targeted American troops and Saudi oil infrastructure. Local reports from the Popular Mobilisation Forces indicate that at least 20 people died during the operation, with Saudi officials justifying the strikes as a necessary act of self-defense.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በኢራቅ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ቡድኖች በጋራ የአየር ጥቃት መቱ። ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች እና በሳዑዲ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ በደረሱ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ነው። የፖፑላር ሞቢላይዜሽን ኃይሎች ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ 20 ሰዎችን እንደገደለ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እርምጃው ለራስ መከላከል የተወሰደ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ameerikaa fi Sa'udii Arabiyaan gamtaadhaan, gareewwan Iraan waliin hidhata qaban kanneen Iraaq keessa jiran irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, waraana Ameerikaa fi bakkeewwan oomisha boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa (dronii) erga raawwatamee booda. Gareen 'Popular Mobilisation Forces' jedhamu akka gabaasetti, namoonni 20 ol ta'an haleellaa kanaan du'aniiru; mootummaan Sa'udii immoo tarkaanfichi of-ittisuuf kan fudhatame ta'uu ibseera.

title: Jayden Seales takes five wickets as West Indies beat Pakistan in first Test
english: The West Indies secured a 90-run victory against Pakistan in the opening Test match held in Trinidad. Bowler Jayden Seales led the team to success by taking five wickets, effectively dismissing Pakistan for 120 runs. The team dedicated this win to the late cricket legend Garry Sobers as they prepare for the second and final match of the series.
amharic: ዌስት ኢንዲስ በትሪኒዳድ በተካሄደው የመጀመሪያው የቴስት የክሪኬት ጨዋታ ፓኪስታንን በ90 ሩጫ በማሸነፍ ተከታታይ ድል አስመዝግቧል። ጄደን ሲልስ አምስት በሮችን በማውረድ ለቡድኑ ድል ቁልፍ ሚና የተጫወተ ሲሆን፣ ፓኪስታን በድምሩ 120 ሩጫ ብቻ እንድታስመዘግብ አድርጓል። የቡድኑ አባላት ይህንን ድል በቅርቡ ላረፈው የክሪኬት ኮከብ ጋሪ ሶበርስ የሰጡት ክብር መሆኑን ገልጸው፣ ለቀጣዩ እና የመጨረሻው የጨዋታ መርሃ ግብር ዝግጅታቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: West Indis tapha qormaata (Test) jalqabaa Tirinidaaditti gaggeeffame irratti Paakistaanirratti injifannoo fiixee 90 argateera. Boowlarichi Jayden Seales wicket shan fudhachuun gareen isaa akka injifatu taasiseera; kunis Paakistaan gabaabaatti akka baatu gargaareera. Gareen kun injifannoo kana garee kriket beekamaa kan ture Garry Soobers yeroo dhihoo kana du'eef yaadannoo ta'uun kan deddeebisan yoo ta'u, amma qophii isaanii tapha lammaffaa fi isa xumuraa irratti xiyyeeffatu.

title: Iran and Oman swap proposals to manage Strait of Hormuz: What we know
english: Iran and Oman are currently negotiating to manage the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz following recent conflicts that disrupted global energy supplies. While Oman suggested a balanced joint oversight agreement, Iran rejected this, proposing a new plan that would grant Tehran significantly more authority over the waterway. This diplomatic struggle remains critical as both nations attempt to resolve ambiguities from a previous agreement that led to renewed hostilities.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በቅርቡ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ መስተጓጎል የፈጠረውን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ለመቆጣጠር በድርድር ላይ ናቸው። ኦማን እኩል የሆነ የጋራ አስተዳደር እንዲኖር ያቀረበችውን ሃሳብ ኢራን ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ ለቴህራን የላቀ ቁጥጥር የሚሰጥ አዲስ የመደራደሪያ ሃሳብ አቅርባለች። ቀደም ሲል የተደረሰው ስምምነት ግልጽ አለመሆን ለግጭት ምክንያት በመሆኑ፣ ሁለቱ ሀገራት አሁን ይህንን ቁልፍ የባህር መስመር ለመቆጣጠር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ እየተወያዩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Iiraan fi Omaan daandii guddicha daldala boba'aa kan ta'e 'Strait of Hormuz' to'achuuf marii gaggeessaa jiru. Omaan to'annoo wal qixa ta'e akka jiraatu yaada dhiheessite iyyuu, Iiraan yaada kana diduun, aangoo to'annoo dabalataa ofiif kennu dhiheessiteetti. Walii galtee kanaan dura ture keessatti rakkoon hiikaa uumamee ture waldhabdee waan uumeef, amma biyyoonni lameen daandii galaana kana nagaatti bulchuuf marii bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Will Germany bring back mandatory military conscription next year?
english: Germany is currently facing a significant military staffing shortage, as a recent voluntary recruitment initiative has failed to meet expectations with only 500 new sign-ups. To strengthen its defense, the government aims to increase its active-duty forces to 260,000 personnel. Due to these low recruitment numbers, there is growing speculation about whether the country will reintroduce mandatory military conscription.
amharic: ጀርመን በአሁኑ ወቅት የጦር ሠራዊቷን ቁጥር ለመጨመር ያቀደችው የበጎ ፈቃድ ምልመላ አነስተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸውን ሰዎች ብቻ በመሳቡ፣ ለከባድ የሰው ኃይል ችግር ተጋልጣለች። መንግሥት ንቁ የጦር ሠራዊቱን ወደ 260,000 ለማሳደግ ግብ የያዘ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን የተመዘገቡት 500 ሰዎች ብቻ ናቸው። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ በጀርመን ግዴታ የሆነ የወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ስርዓትን እንደገና የመመለስ አስፈላጊነት ላይ ውይይቶች እየተደረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Jarmaniin yeroo ammaa loltoota ishee dabaluuf yaalii fedhii irratti hundaa'e gooteen, namoota 500 qofa waan argatteef hanqina humna waraanaa cimaa keessa jirti. Mootummaan lakkoofsa loltoota isaa gara 260,000 tti ol guddisuuf karoora qabaatus, namoonni fedhiin galmaa'an hedduu muraasa dha. Haala kanaan walqabatee, biyyattiin tajaajila waraanaa dirqamaa deebisanii jalqabuu fi dhiisuu irratti mariin gurguddaan gaggeeffamaa jira.
